Local person detection dependencies

TensorFlow.js 4.22.0
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tensorflow/tfjs@4.22.0/dist/tf.min.js
COCO-SSD 2.2.3
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tensorflow-models/coco-ssd@2.2.3/dist/coco-ssd.min.js
Official source and API:
https://github.com/tensorflow/tfjs-models/tree/master/coco-ssd

SSDLite MobileNet V2 graph and all five weight shards:
https://storage.googleapis.com/tfjs-models/savedmodel/ssdlite_mobilenet_v2/model.json
The downloaded public graph and shard bytes are pinned by ASSET-SHA256.json.

TensorFlow.js, COCO-SSD, and the upstream model distribution use Apache 2.0.
The upstream TensorFlow.js models license is retained in LICENSE.
worker.js is application code that runs the fixed libraries on the CPU.

The detector returns generic 'person' bounding boxes. It does not recognize
identity, measure distance, locate anatomical foot landmarks, or guarantee
complete-body visibility. The box bottom-center is only a framing reference.
Camera and photo pixels stay on the user's device; model resources are served
from the same site. No inference endpoint receives user images.
